fields.name: CARD-NUM
fields.description: Card number — kept as string to preserve leading zeros and avoid numeric overflow.

fields.name: CARD-ACCT-ID
fields.description: Associated account identifier — 11-digit unsigned integer matching ACCT-ID in CVACT01Y.

fields.name: CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME
fields.description: Name embossed on the physical card.

fields.name: CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE
fields.description: Card expiration date (note: typo 'EXPIRAION' preserved from original copybook).

fields.name: FILLER
fields.description: Reserved/unused bytes to pad the record to 150 bytes. Excluded from the PySpark DataFrame.
